rationale: dual_domain_bilateral_n2i-claude-agentic: warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=2, train_n=400, n_iter=30, val_n=200, batch_size=1, grad_clip=1.0, lr=0.005, proj_n_bf=2, img_n_bf=1, outer_wall_s=1050, seed=42, rationale=iter-4 dual_domain_bilateral_n2i, ONE-KNOB: projection-domain BF DEPTH proj_n_bf 1->2 (vs iter-3 base: proj_n_bf=1, img_n_bf=1, n_iter=30). PRIOR trajectory: iter-1 (n_iter120) SSIM0.9567 recon_rmse9.80e-4 > base9.65e-4; iter-2 (img depth3) SSIM0.9560 WORSE; iter-3 (n_iter30 early-stop) SSIM0.9563 recon_rmse9.86e-4 ~= base9.84e-4 (early-stop reaches FBP PARITY but never beats it). All hr=0. So image-domain BF + optimization steps are exhausted; recon asymptotes to FBP from ABOVE. NEW AXIS: the projection (sinogram) domain has only ever been at depth 1. KNOB: proj_n_bf 1->2 (2 stacked projection BFs = extra 3 proj params). HYPOTHESIS: denoising the 64-view half-sinogram MORE before FBP could suppress the sparse-view streak noise that the image-domain BF cannot reach, so the N2I recon might finally dip recon_rmse BELOW baseline (hr>0). If hr stays 0, the projection domain is ALSO bounded by FBP on dense breast and the N2I ceiling is confirmed to hold across BOTH domains. FAILURE watched: findings.md warns projection BF that is too strong -> view inconsistency -> new artifacts (PSNR/SSIM drop). BUDGET: proj depth2 adds one sinogram unfold per half-pass; cheap; n_iter=30 -> ~1000s (iter-3 ran 1047s). ONE knob: proj_n_bf 1->2.
